explication: ScanRuler is a browser-based 3D scan inspection and modeling application. Its main workflow loads a scan, performs measurements and analysis, and presents results in interactive workspaces; users can also inspect flatbed images, reverse-engineer solids, and edit meshes. The README documents these capabilities, while the excerpts and source index provide only selected implementation links, so unsampled subsystem connections are omitted or marked unverified.
